subject: Human Body
title: The Vagus Nerve
description: A fast breakdown of The Vagus Nerve for builders.

hook.text: The vagus nerve wanders from brain to gut, touching the heart, lungs, and stomach along the way. 'Vagus' means wanderer.

buildup.text: It carries 80% of parasympathetic signals. Heart rate, digestion, and inflammation all fall under its influence.

discovery.text: Vagal tone measures health. High vagal tone means your body recovers from stress quickly. Low tone means it lingers.

twist.text: Stimulating the vagus nerve treats epilepsy and depression. An implanted device sends electrical pulses to the nerve.

climax.text: Cold exposure, singing, and even gargling can stimulate the vagus nerve naturally. The body has built-in calm buttons.

punchline.text: One wandering nerve connects your brain to your gut.
